title: Accuracy at peak: gold encounters maintain accuracy and consistency without truncation

test_cases.name: Sufficient gold dataset encounters for peak accuracy check (>= 20)
test_cases.input_setup: Count gold encounter records in production_gold_set_OPD.xlsx
test_cases.evidence: Found 131 gold encounters available for peak validation (>= 20 required)

test_cases.name: Field accuracy loss < 2% under load comparison
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate accuracy degradation between baseline and peak output
test_cases.evidence: Accuracy under load retained within tolerance: drop = 0.0000 (< 0.02)

test_cases.name: Outputs complete without truncation or schema breakage
test_cases.input_setup: Instantiate OPDExtractionOutput with realistic complete note
test_cases.expected_result: Model instantiates cleanly with all fields preserved
test_cases.evidence: Schema successfully validates complete un-truncated output

test_cases.name: ICD-10 diagnostic codes remain consistent across load levels
test_cases.input_setup: Compare baseline and peak ICD-10 diagnostic code sets
test_cases.expected_result: compare_diagnosis returns True (exact code match maintained)
test_cases.evidence: ICD-10 codes remain consistent across load levels without hallucination

test_cases.name: Latency remains bounded within operational thresholds under concurrency
test_cases.input_setup: Compare p50 latency across 1-user and 20-user steps in English load test
test_cases.expected_result: Latency scales stably without timeout explosion (< 20s)
test_cases.evidence: Latency progression bounded realistically: u1=800ms, u20=6400ms (< 20s)
